title: Research Method
text: A good research answer separates evidence, inference, and uncertainty. Claims should be traceable to local evidence.

title: Comparison Method
text: A comparison should evaluate the same dimensions for each subject and identify where evidence is missing or inconsistent.

title: Multi-hop Method
text: A multi-hop answer should expose intermediate relationships rather than jumping directly from the first entity to the final conclusion.

title: Timeline Method
text: A timeline should order dated evidence, distinguish established dates from estimates, and flag gaps or contradictions.

title: Offline Constraint
text: Offline research must use locally stored models and datasets and must not depend on network requests during use.
